I don't know if you are interested in history, but there are many historic relics of ancient Talking Island in this area. default/30311-1.htm.text: Collin Windawood: This tower was erected 514 years before the empire was formed, as a memorial to the Elven victory over the Orcs. The Elves won because they had allied with the Humans and taught them magic as they fought together. However, in the end, the Elves were also betrayed by the Humans and…

default/30311-2.htm.text: Collin Windawood: This island was originally the sacred ground of the Elves of Light. I heard they were powerful enchanters, who communed with spirits. At the time when the Elves began the war with the Orcs, they also began to teach Humans magic to increase their army's strength. Thus, they built t…

Q00006_StepIntoTheFuture/30311-01.html.text: Sir Collin Windawood: Hard to find someone who's always on the move, huh? What brings you here?

links.text: "Baulro told me to pay you a visit and give you this."

Q00006_StepIntoTheFuture/30311-04.html.text: Sir Collin Windawood: Go to Gatekeeper Roxxy and tell her I sent you. She'll help you. Giran is more hectic than you're used to, so be careful. Good luck!

Q00155_FindSirWindawood/30311-01.html.text: Collin Windawood: Hmm... something urgent? Ah, a message from our lord. Another meeting? Q00212_TrialOfDuty/30311-01.html.text: Sir Collin Windawood: Could these actually be the bones of Leon? I heard of his glorious death during the battle against Orcs... What a loss... Never did I expect that I would see you like this, my beloved nephew! I regret I wasn't with you at the moment of your death! Young Warrior, My family is i…

Q00212_TrialOfDuty/30311-02.html.text: Sir Collin Windawood: Young Warrior, thank you for recovering my nephew's remains and bringing them back to us. My family is in your debt. Now please take the letter that I gave you to Priest Dustin of the Town of Giran . Thank you. May the light of Einhasad guide your path.

Q00006_StepIntoTheFuture/30311-02.html.text: Sir Collin Windawood: Want to go to Giran, huh? Baulro sent you? I told him the story a while back. You may be fresh out of school, but worldly experiences will help shape your future. Giran is a busy place and unexpected things can happen, so stay calm and focused! Meet Gatekeeper Roxxy and tell h…

Q00006_StepIntoTheFuture/30311-03.html.text: Sir Collin Windawood: So where is Baulro's letter? Did you miss something? Hurry up and bring me the letter!
